_approach: HexD's contribution to the fusion, per the Aesthetics Wiki definition (bitcrushing applied to an existing groove, 'hexxing' it): the percussion loop, not the kick, is the busiest layer — a compressed, low-bit-depth-implying cowbell/tomLow/perc cycle that stutters against a stripped-back Jersey kick (just beat 1 and the a-of-3). Keep this groove's non-percussion parts sparse so the crushed loop reads as the point of the pattern, mirroring HexD tracks where the bitcrush IS the hook, not a seasoning.
